caveats: Development and Validation are pre-OOS historical segments; neither is True OOS.
Bootstrap intervals describe uncertainty under resampling assumptions and do not prove future profitability.
Moving-block resampling reduces but does not eliminate serial-dependence risk.
Eight-symbol screening creates multiple-comparison risk; no formal FDR significance is claimed.
No strategy, scoring, threshold, risk, or live-execution behavior was changed.

classification_rules.PROMISING_NOT_CONFIRMED: observed expectancy > 0 in both segments but robust criteria not met
classification_rules.ROBUST_NEGATIVE: ordinary and moving-block expectancy and mean-R 95% CI upper bounds < 0 in both Development and Validation
classification_rules.ROBUST_POSITIVE: ordinary and moving-block expectancy and mean-R 95% CI lower bounds > 0 in both Development and Validation
